body:
I Squared Capital, the Miami-based infrastructure investor, is in advanced talks to buy German outdoor advertising group Ströer, Reuters reported on Thursday, Nov. 26, citing two people familiar with the matter [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). The talks revive negotiations that stalled earlier this year. If they progress, I Squared would line up financing, though one of the people said the talks could still collapse, as earlier efforts did [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/).

Reuters did not report an offer price. It put Ströer's market value at 2.08 billion euros ($2.28 billion), and said, citing LSEG data, that the value has fallen more than 30% since January 2025 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). Spokespeople for Ströer and I Squared declined to comment, and Infravia did not immediately respond [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/).

I Squared first pursued Ströer's billboard business in 2025 but could not secure enough backing from additional investors [[2]](https://invidis.com/news/2026/07/out-of-home-investors-seek-control-of-stroer/). In May, Blackstone joined I Squared in a bid for the whole company before dropping out, Bloomberg reported at the time [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). In July, Manager Magazin reported that I Squared and Paris-based Infravia Capital Partners had reached an understanding with Ströer's two largest shareholders on a deal valuing the company at about 2.5 billion euros, roughly 20% above its recent market value; no deal followed [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/)[[2]](https://invidis.com/news/2026/07/out-of-home-investors-seek-control-of-stroer/).

The holders who would decide any deal are co-founder and chief executive Udo Müller, with 24%, and founding-family member Dirk Ströer, with 20%, according to LSEG data cited by Reuters. US activist ValueAct holds 2.9% [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). Manager Magazin had reported in July that Dirk Ströer planned to sell his whole stake while Müller would sell part of his and stay involved [[2]](https://invidis.com/news/2026/07/out-of-home-investors-seek-control-of-stroer/).

p: 마이애미에 본사를 둔 인프라 투자사 I Squared Capital이 독일 옥외광고 그룹 Ströer 인수를 위한 협상을 막바지 단계에서 진행 중이라고 Reuters가 11월 26일(목) 사안에 정통한 두 관계자를 인용해 보도했다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). 이번 협상은 올해 초 중단됐던 논의를 되살린 것이다. 협상이 진전되면 I Squared가 자금 조달에 나서게 되지만, 관계자 중 한 명은 앞선 시도들처럼 이번 협상도 결렬될 수 있다고 말했다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/).

Reuters는 인수 제시 가격을 보도하지 않았다. 다만 Ströer의 시가총액이 20억 8천만 유로(22억 8천만 달러)이며, LSEG 데이터를 인용해 2025년 1월 이후 30% 넘게 하락했다고 전했다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). Ströer와 I Squared 대변인은 논평을 거부했고, Infravia는 즉각 응답하지 않았다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/).

I Squared는 2025년 Ströer의 빌보드 사업 부문을 처음 노렸으나 추가 투자자들로부터 충분한 지원을 확보하지 못했다 [[2]](https://invidis.com/news/2026/07/out-of-home-investors-seek-control-of-stroer/). Bloomberg는 당시 5월에 Blackstone이 I Squared와 함께 회사 전체에 대한 인수에 나섰다가 이탈했다고 보도했다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). 7월에는 Manager Magazin이 I Squared와 파리에 본사를 둔 Infravia Capital Partners가 Ströer의 최대주주 두 곳과 기업가치 약 25억 유로(최근 시가총액보다 약 20% 높은 수준)로 평가하는 거래에 의견 접근을 이뤘다고 보도했으나, 이후 거래는 성사되지 않았다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/)[[2]](https://invidis.com/news/2026/07/out-of-home-investors-seek-control-of-stroer/).

Reuters가 인용한 LSEG 데이터에 따르면 거래의 성사 여부를 좌우할 주주는 공동창업자이자 최고경영자(CEO)인 Udo Müller(지분 24%)와 창업 일가의 Dirk Ströer(지분 20%)다. 미국 행동주의 투자자 ValueAct는 2.9%를 보유하고 있다 [[1]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/exclusive-fund-i-squared-advanced-talks-buy-german/). Manager Magazin은 7월에 Dirk Ströer가 보유 지분 전량을 매각할 계획이고, Müller는 지분 일부를 매각하되 경영에는 계속 관여할 것이라고 보도한 바 있다 [[2]](https://invidis.com/news/2026/07/out-of-home-investors-seek-control-of-stroer/).
